key_finding: POET's board is structurally a photonics-and-supply-chain hybrid: a working CEO/Chairman who came from semiconductor process development (Venkatesan ex-GlobalFoundries / Freescale), a lead independent director who already ran the silicon-photonics company Kotura through a successful sale to Mellanox (Malinge), a 32-year semiconductor/optoelectronics operator (Riley), Arista Networks' current Chief Procurement Officer (Lan Ende), a public-company CFO/COO veteran (Tirva), and the most recent addition (July 2025) Sohail Khan who carries the deepest silicon-carbide / Coherent / Agere CEO pattern recognition on the board. Chris Tsiofas retired after 13 years as Audit Committee Chair at the June 2025 AGM — the audit chair seat reconfigured during 2025. The composition is calibrated for a CPO-architecture company that may or may not get qualified at hyperscalers; if it does, the board has the supply-chain (Lan Ende), packaging (Riley), and chip-CEO (Khan, Malinge) pattern-matching to govern through scale.

ceo_chairman.name: Dr. Suresh Venkatesan
ceo_chairman.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
education: B.Tech. Electrical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology
career: 2015-present: Chairman and CEO, POET Technologies
2009-2015: SVP Technology Development, GlobalFoundries — led 28nm ramp, instrumental in 14nm transfer and qualification
Earlier: Multiple leadership positions at Freescale Semiconductor (Austin, Texas); Freescale Fellow (2007) for CMOS technology contributions
Pre-Freescale: Motorola — inducted into Scientific Advisory Board Associates (SABA, 2004)
ceo_chairman.ip_accomplishments: Over 25 US patents; co-author of over 50 technical papers
ceo_chairman.framing: Venkatesan is the rare photonics-platform CEO who came directly from running a leading-edge foundry process technology organisation. The 28nm GlobalFoundries ramp under his leadership is the single most concrete operating credential — that node was a meaningful inflection in the GlobalFoundries-Samsung-TSMC competitive triangle, and he ran it. Bringing that semiconductor process discipline to a wafer-level photonic integration platform is precisely what POET's product strategy requires.

board_of_directors.name: Jean-Louis Malinge
career: 2004-2013: President and CEO, Kotura (silicon photonics pioneer; sold to Mellanox 2013 for $82M)
Pre-2004: 15+ years at Corning Incorporated; held various executive positions including Vice President of Optical Networking Components
Current: Partner at ARCH Venture Partners (~$2B AUM early-stage venture capital firm)
Current: Managing Director at YADAIS (photonics and telecoms industry consulting)
board_of_directors.framing: Malinge is the most directly relevant operating credential on the board for POET's strategic thesis. Running Kotura — a silicon photonics pioneer with products in three of the top five telecom companies — and selling it to Mellanox is the exact precedent POET is trying to set with its Optical Interposer platform. ARCH Venture Partners affiliation provides ongoing pattern recognition on deep-tech venture economics. The Corning tenure brings 15+ years of optical networking component depth pre-Kotura.

board_of_directors.name: Theresa Lan Ende
board_of_directors.role: Director (advisor since June 2022, formal director from October 2022 AGM)
career: Current: Chief Procurement Officer (formerly Chief Procurement Director), Arista Networks
Previous 10 years at Arista: Senior Director of Global Supply Chain Management
Earlier: Supply chain and operations roles at JDS Uniphase, Force10 Networks
20-year span at Cisco Systems and ROLM Telecommunications in program management and planning roles
board_of_directors.recognition: Silicon Valley Business Journal 'Top 100 Women of Influence' (2019)
board_of_directors.framing: Lan Ende's role as Arista Networks' CPO is the single most consequential customer-side credential on the board. Arista is one of the dominant high-speed Ethernet switch vendors into hyperscaler AI builds; her supply-chain credential maps directly onto the qualification-and-volume challenge POET faces. The JDS Uniphase / Force10 / Cisco / ROLM career is supply-chain-heavy in exactly the optical and switching domains POET targets.

board_of_directors.name: Glen Riley
career: Most recent: General Manager of Filter Solutions Business Unit, Qorvo (highly integrated RF modules for flagship mobile phones)
Earlier: Managing Director, TriQuint International HQ (Singapore)
Earlier: General Manager, TriQuint GaAs Foundry Business
Earlier: General Manager, TriQuint Optoelectronics Business
Earlier: CEO, Opticalis (optical component start-up)
Earlier: VP responsible for Agere's high-speed/long-haul optoelectronics business

board_of_directors.framing: Riley brings 32 years across semiconductors and optoelectronics, with three distinct subsidiary-GM roles at TriQuint plus a Qorvo BU role and an Agere optoelectronics VP role. The GaAs foundry experience is directly relevant to compound-semiconductor process management — adjacent to POET's interposer technology stack.

board_of_directors.name: Robert (Bob) Tirva
board_of_directors.role: Director; Audit Committee member (succeeded Chris Tsiofas at June 2025 AGM)
career: Until 2022: President, COO, and CFO of Sonim Technologies Inc. (acquired by AJP Holding Company in 2022)
Earlier: Various management positions at IBM, Broadcom Corporation, Dropbox, Intermedia Cloud Communications Inc.
30+ years executive experience in technology industry
board_of_directors.framing: Tirva is the public-company CFO/COO veteran on the board. The combined CFO + COO + President role at Sonim through to acquisition is the operating-execution pattern. The IBM / Broadcom / Dropbox career mix brings cross-industry technology-finance perspective. With Tsiofas's retirement, Tirva's Audit Committee role takes on additional weight.

board_of_directors.name: Sohail Khan
board_of_directors.role: Director; Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee member
career: EVP of Wideband Gap Electronics and President of SiC, LLC at Coherent Corp.
CEO and Head of Strategy at Agere Systems — extensive M&A experience
President and CEO of ViXS Systems Inc. (fabless semiconductor company)
Managing Partner, K5 Innovations LLC
16 years on the board of LightPath Technologies
Board member, Intersil Corporation
board_of_directors.framing: Khan is the most senior chip-CEO addition to the POET board. The Coherent silicon-carbide EVP role is the most adjacent operating credential — Coherent (formerly II-VI) is one of the dominant compound-semiconductor materials companies, and SiC is structurally similar to the III-V materials POET works with. The Agere CEO and ViXS CEO roles provide M&A pattern recognition at multiple scale points. LightPath Technologies (optical components) 16-year board tenure brings deep optical-component industry depth.

departures_at_june_2025_agm.name: Chris Tsiofas
departures_at_june_2025_agm.role: Departed Audit Committee Chair after 13 years on the board
departures_at_june_2025_agm.framing: Tsiofas's 13-year tenure spans most of POET's modern history including the pivot from a development-stage compound semiconductor company to the Optical Interposer platform thesis. Departure clears the Audit Committee Chair seat — Bob Tirva (joined December 2024) is the natural successor with the requisite public-company-CFO credentials.

board_composition_observation: POET's six-director board (post-Tsiofas departure, including new arrival Khan) is unusually well-credentialed for a pre-commercial-revenue company at $313M cash. The composition reads: working photonics CEO (Venkatesan) + ex-silicon-photonics-CEO (Malinge) + ex-compound-semiconductor-EVP (Khan, Coherent SiC) + 32-year optoelectronics operator (Riley) + working hyperscaler-customer CPO (Lan Ende, Arista) + public-company CFO/COO (Tirva). Compare this with a Sivers-style US-listing-prep board (heavy on financial-engineering and IPO advisors) — POET's composition is calibrated for operational governance of a still-pre-revenue platform company, with the expectation that the next 18-24 months will determine whether the Optical Interposer becomes a qualified component in hyperscaler CPO supply chains. There is no separate CFO on POET's public team page, which is structurally noteworthy for a $313M-cash company — the CFO function is presumably handled through corporate-level finance functions and the Audit Committee.
